title: Helpdesk call about a laptop that will not connect

setting.situation: An employee calls the IT helpdesk because their laptop cannot join the office wifi and they have a client call in forty minutes.

participant.brief: Your remote tools can reset the laptop's network profile. There is one spare laptop at the front desk until 5 pm. Hardware repairs go to an outside vendor and usually take two or three days.

counterpart.name: Priya Nair
counterpart.background: Works from the office three days a week. Fine with most software, lost when it comes to network settings.

objective: Get Priya online, on her own laptop or the spare, before the 3 pm call.
opening_message: Hi, my laptop will not connect to the wifi at all and I have a client call at three. Can you help?

key_moments.description: First questions: which network, what error, whether anything changed recently.
The profile reset, and how the steps are explained over the phone.
Bringing up the spare laptop if the reset does not work in time.
What happens to the broken laptop after the call.
